# Config fields for the reverse thruster

**Parent:** AH-0MUZCSB4B00107RG — Add a reverse thruster to the Asteroids ship control scheme
**Covers parent AC:** AC2 (individually customisable & persisted)

## Goal

Add the persisted, individually-tunable reverse-thruster settings to the ship config so the
Asteroids reverse thruster is configurable independently of the forward thrust values and is
switched off completely with a single master boolean.

## Context

`ShipConfig` (`src/core/configTypes.ts`) is the single ship tuning record; defaults live in
`src/core/configDefaults.ts` / `DEFAULT_CONFIG`, the CSV codec (column order, coercion, validation,
serialisation) lives in `src/core/csv.ts`, and the shipped values live in `src/data/ship-config.csv`.
`coerceShipConfig` is the read path (must default-merge for legacy files) and `validateShipConfig` is
the dev write-path validator (`vite/plugins/configCsvPlugin.ts`).

## Desired change

- Add `asteroidsReverseEnabled: boolean` (default `true`), `asteroidsReverseThrustAcceleration: number`
  (proposed default 200 px/s²) and `asteroidsReverseMaxSpeed: number` (proposed default 120 px/s).
- Extend `SHIP_COLUMN_ORDER`, `coerceShipConfig` (add a boolean coercion helper: `true`/`false`,
  `1`/`0`, blank → default), `serializeShipConfigs` and `validateShipConfig`.
- Add the three columns/values to `src/data/ship-config.csv`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `ShipConfig` exposes `asteroidsReverseEnabled`, `asteroidsReverseThrustAcceleration` and `asteroidsReverseMaxSpeed`, independent of the forward `thrustAcceleration` and `maxSpeed` values (AC2).
- [ ] The three reverse fields round-trip through `src/data/ship-config.csv` and the config store (`serializeShipConfig` → `coerceShipConfig`).
- [ ] Legacy configs and CSVs that predate the fields load with sane defaults: `asteroidsReverseEnabled` defaults to `true`, with reverse acceleration and reverse max speed falling back to their defaults (AC2).
- [ ] Malformed reverse values are reported by `validateShipConfig` on the dev write path and fall back to defaults on the read path.
- [ ] `src/data/ship-config.csv` carries the new columns and `src/data/csv-seed.test.ts` matches `DEFAULT_CONFIG`.

## Dependencies

- None.

## Test-first

Write the failing tests for this slice first, then implement until the whole suite is green before committing (the implement workflow requires build + tests to pass on every commit, so tests land with the code in this child).

**Key Files:**

- `src/core/configTypes.ts` — add the three `ShipConfig` fields.
- `src/core/configDefaults.ts` — defaults for the three fields.
- `src/core/csv.ts` — `SHIP_COLUMN_ORDER`, boolean coercion, `coerceShipConfig`, `serializeShipConfigs`, `validateShipConfig`.
- `src/data/ship-config.csv` — shipped row gains the three columns.
- `src/core/csv.test.ts`, `src/core/configDefaults.test.ts`, `src/data/csv-seed.test.ts` — round-trip, legacy-default and validation tests.
